eyebrow: Governance
title: How governance is organized
lede: Research Data Governance sits within Data Governance at Northfield University. Its committee decides which definitions become official.
---

Every term is created, changed or retired through a lifecycle process that
belongs to one governance process. The council taking part in that process,
or in any process it belongs to, governs the term.
